rundown: Hawks beat Pistons 107-97 at State Farm Arena in Atlanta, GA. Hawks came back: they were down 52-51 at the half. The 4th quarter decided it: Hawks won it 33-12. Their win chance dropped as low as 7% along the way.
Leading the way — Pistons: Isaiah Joe 19 pts; Cade Cunningham 15 ast; Ausar Thompson 11 reb. Hawks: Nickeil Alexander-Walker 27 pts; Dyson Daniels 8 ast, 14 reb.
Where Hawks won it: they won the boards 62-43 and turned it over 15 times to 16.

Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Pistons closed as 2.5-point favorites and lost outright to Hawks; Hawks won as the underdog at +114; the total closed at 224.5 and they combined for 204, under by 20.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 22, 3:24 PM ET. It had Pistons 51% and Hawks 49%, projecting Pistons 114.7 – Hawks 114.3 (229.1 total, Pistons by 0.4).

Final: Pistons 97 – Hawks 107. Wrong winner: it had Pistons at 51%, and Hawks (49%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Pistons came in with a league-average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (10-5, 114.5 scored and 108.7 allowed a game over 15 games), worth about 92 and 93 games of evidence. Projected to score 114.7, they scored 97 (−17.7 points, 15% under); projected to allow 114.3, they allowed 107 (−7.3 points, 6% under).

Hawks came in with a 2% above average attack and a league-average defense (10-6, 117.3 scored and 114.6 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 93 and 92 games of evidence. Projected to score 114.3, they scored 107 (−7.3 points, 6% under); projected to allow 114.7, they allowed 97 (−17.7 points, 15% under).

The bigger miss was Pistons' scoring (-17.7 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 204 against 229.1 projected (-25.1), about the 8th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Hawks by 10 against Pistons by 0.4 projected, about the 81st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
ATL ML (+114) at +114: the algo gave it 45% vs 45% fair (+0.4 pts) — ungraded; lost to the close (closing fair chance 45%). DET ML (-135) at -135: the algo gave it 55% vs 55% fair (-0.4 pts) — ungraded; lost to the close (closing fair chance 55%). ATL +2.5 (-114) at -114: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (+0.6 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close. DET -2.5 (-106) at -106: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (-0.6 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close. OVER 224.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close. UNDER 224.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 62% of bets on Pistons, 60% of the money — Hawks covered; total: 74% of bets on the over, 78% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 71% of bets on Pistons, 60% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Pistons, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.884 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +10.3 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 134 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.992 and gives home teams -0.1 points. Team corrections so far: Pistons attack ×1.007, defense ×1.023 (8 games); Hawks attack ×1.008, defense ×1.010 (8 games).

The tracker grades it from the final within a few minutes; then it joins the learning.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
